name: Haystack
description: Current scene graph datasets suffer from strong long-tail distributions of their predicate classes. Due to a very low number of some predicate classes in the test sets, no reliable metrics can be retrieved for the rarest classes. We construct a new panoptic scene graph dataset and a set of metrics that are designed as a benchmark for the predictive performance especially on rare predicate classes. To construct the new dataset, we propose a model-assisted annotation pipeline that efficiently finds rare predicate classes that are hidden in a large set of images like needles in a haystack. Contrary to prior scene graph datasets, Haystack contains explicit negative annotations, i.e. annotations that a given relation does not have a certain predicate class. Negative annotations are helpful especially in the field of scene graph generation and open up a whole new set of possibilities to improve current scene graph generation models. reputation: A newer scene graph benchmark designed to address long-tail predicate evaluation and is gaining attention in vision research.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark with explicit negative annotations and strong class imbalance; especially focused on rare predicates, so macro-averaged metrics are more informative than micro-averaged ones.
